notes: Level 5: the commander now walks up to the helmet and kneels without sliding back first.
Level 5: the settlers now arrive even if a raider is still alive after the turret is built, so you no longer lose stars for it.
Level 5: when the commander kneels to pick up the helmet, a warm light now falls on them at night so the moment can be seen, and the kneel animation is smoother.
The level name (LV.4) and Help buttons are now full phone-size tap targets.
Order bubbles over a busy kiosk now lift off the shelf counts and guide lines instead of covering them.
KILN now tells the commander to fall back when an attack leaves them at 3 health or less, and again when they are knocked down.
Behind the scenes: the automatic test player now stops close enough to pick up the Level 5 helmet, so the story levels stay checkable.
Level 1: Vale's crew plate now shows the same piped uniform as the other three bays.
Behind the scenes: the story check now pictures every spoken line and flags speakers who are off screen, so story fixes are easier to judge.
Level 1: a long bright flash from the reactor now shows before the commander says "That light", KILN's power line is reworded, and the empty camera move during the storm is gone.

Level 2: KILN names the two-pod trick before any pod comes in, Pip, Okafor and KILN's log lines are reworded (the log now records the launch), the camera swings out to the fifth pod before the commander answers, Rhee no longer sets down a med crate, and the help text no longer mentions a gate.
Level 3: new wording for Tam, Sela, KILN and Okafor; the wall now comes before Tam offers to run the dome, which waits for one more load of greens at the kiosk.
Level 4: KILN's lines are clearer: the date check, scanning the wreck for the flight recorder, the galley, why the crew left the ship, and the red shudder returning on the ridge.
Level 5: KILN sends you out to the road, the guard post and turret sit by the road, the arrows lead to the road and straight to the helmet, and the goal reads till sunrise.
